maria_support: @luis could you paste the exact curl + body you used? seeing a bunch of 400s from /v1/rerank for your org

luis_customer: yep — here you go:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries": ["find pricing"], "items": ["pricing page","pricing FAQ"], "topk": "5"}'
```
Response: 400 Bad Request
```
{"error":"invalid_request","message":"items must be an array of objects with 'id' and 'text' fields","code":400}
```

oliver_engineer: I can repro locally. Validator expects items: [{id,text}]. When items is array<string> we raise ValidationError. Also topk is a string here — should be numeric. Missing request_id makes log correlation harder. Stack snippet I saw: `rerank.validate_payload -> raise ValidationError("items schema mismatch")`

kai_sdk: FWIW the SDK change in v2.3.7 stopped converting List[str] -> List[{id,text}] automatically. That surfaced this customer payload. We'll ship a patch to coerce and add a deprecation warning.

maria_support: Quick workaround for you, Luis — send items as objects and make topk an int. Example payload to use:
```
{
  "queries": ["find pricing"],
  "items": [
    {"id": "c1", "text": "pricing page"},
    {"id": "c2", "text": "pricing FAQ"}
  ],
  "topk": 5,
  "request_id": "support-3790012345"
}
```

luis_customer: applied that exact payload — call now returns 200 and I get reranked candidates. Thanks! :tada:

oliver_engineer: I'll open RW-1123 to patch the SDK and improve the 400 error text to call out specific field mismatches (items/topk/request_id).

devops_bot: alert cleared — rerank 400 spike for org-123 resolved, error rate back to baseline.
